biography: Nandini Parthasarathy is Academic Advisor to the Cedar Ridge Schools Trust, a group of 9 CBSE schools in Tamil Nadu. She was Principal of Cedar Ridge Senior School for eleven years and now coaches principals and coordinators across the group. She sits on the governing board of two school societies.
Nandini Parthasarathy, a former school principal, speaks on principal mentoring at the South India School Leaders Forum.

Arvind Chakraborty directs the Eastern Schools Network, a network of schools with 14 member campuses across West Bengal and Odisha. He previously served as headmaster of a residential school and now oversees academic standards, principal appointments and shared teacher training for the network.

Fatima Qureshi-Dalal is a school improvement partner to more than 20 independent schools in Maharashtra and Gujarat. Before founding Slate Compass Advisory she was Head of School at an IB World School. She advises school boards on leadership succession and academic strategy.

Harpreet Sodhi chairs the Sodhi Education Society, which owns and governs 6 schools in Punjab. As promoter she appoints principals and sets fee and expansion policy. She is also a member of the state private schools association executive.
Harpreet Sodhi, chairperson of the Sodhi Education Society, joined a panel on affordable private school governance.

Lakshmi Venkataraghavan is Regional Director for the southern region of Greenfield Learning Trust, supporting 9 schools across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. A former principal, she leads principal reviews and curriculum alignment for the region.

Prakash Deshmane was Principal of a CBSE school in Pune for fourteen years. He now runs Principal's Studio, a leadership coaching practice that mentors principals at 25 schools. He regularly facilitates workshops for school management committees.

Sunita Agnihotri is a trustee of three school societies in Uttar Pradesh, including Gomti Vidya Trust. She was Principal of a girls' school in Lucknow until 2018 and now advises trustees on governance, audits and principal hiring.

Rohan Mukund founded Standards Bridge, a quality-assurance and accreditation service that has audited 40 schools across Gujarat and Rajasthan. He earlier served as Vice Principal and then Principal of a boarding school.

Devika Nambiar is Head of School at a K-12 school in Kochi and academic advisor to the Kerala Independent Schools Association, which represents 60 member schools. She convenes the association's principals' council.

Gurpreet Ahluwalia-Nair is CEO of Sunrise Community Schools, a chain of 30 affordable-fee schools across Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh. She founded the group and recruits and develops principals for each campus.

Gayatri Menon-Pillai trains school trustees and governing board members from 40 schools through Trustee Practice Lab. She is a former principal of a CBSE school and sits on the governing board of a school society in Bengaluru.
Tarun Vyas has been Principal of Malwa Public School since 2012. He chairs the Indore principals' forum and has presented at regional CBSE principal conferences.
Meenakshi Iyyer is Academic Director of Kongu Vidyalaya Group, which runs 5 CBSE-affiliated schools. She leads curriculum planning and teacher appraisal across the group.
Sanjay Goradia founded ClassLedger, a school ERP platform used by 180 schools for admissions, fees and attendance. He works with school owners and principals on implementation.
Sanjay Goradia, founder of ClassLedger, spoke on digital school administration for private school owners.

Aditi Phukan founded the Brahmaputra Teachers' Collective, a teacher-training programme that works with 60 schools in Assam and Meghalaya. She trained as a primary school teacher and later led a school improvement unit.
Joseph Kurian Mathai served on a state school curriculum council until 2023 and advised on school textbook reform. He was earlier principal of a government higher secondary school.
Rekha Bansal-Oberoi was Head of School at an international school in Gurugram until 2021. She now consults for school boards on head-of-school searches and strategy for 7 schools in Delhi NCR.
Imran Sheikh founded Principals' Fellowship, a year-long leadership fellowship with cohorts of principals from 70 schools. He previously taught mathematics and coordinated academics at a K-12 school.
Pooja Dhawale is Director of Operations at Orange City Schools, a network of schools with 7 campuses in Vidarbha. She manages campus principals, admissions and compliance.
Chandrashekhar Polavarapu is the founder trustee of Krishna Valley Residential School. He also serves on the governing boards of two other schools in Andhra Pradesh.
Mallika Sen-Ghoshal is an IB curriculum consultant who works with 12 IB schools on programme authorisation and teacher development. She was an IB coordinator for nine years.

Dinesh Kapadnis is Vice President of School Partnerships at Pragya Learning Publishers, whose curriculum materials are adopted by more than 500 schools. He manages relationships with school group heads and principals.
Shalini Rawat is Principal and a trustee of Doon Heights School, a boarding school. She was previously Principal of a day school in Dehradun and mentors new heads from neighbouring hill schools.
Anwar Peerzada founded SafeCampus India, a school-safety audit service delivered to 35 schools in Madhya Pradesh. He previously worked in school administration.
Debashish Lahiri leads Clean Classrooms Foundation, a sanitation and hygiene programme running in 120 schools across Odisha. He works with district school officials and school principals.
Mohan Lal Chaudhry retired in 2019 after serving as headmaster of two schools in Rajasthan. He occasionally speaks to teachers' groups.
Zoya Fernandes advises 8 Indian-curriculum schools in the UAE on CBSE affiliation and leadership development. She was Principal of a CBSE school in Dubai before becoming a consultant.
Anil Deshmukh is Principal of Nagpur Vidya Mandir and sits on the managing committee of a school society. He mentors vice principals from two sister schools.
Kishore Tambe teaches mathematics at Shivaji High School and coaches the school's quiz team.
Ananya Roychowdhury manages content marketing at LearnLoop, an edtech company producing learning videos for school students.
Vishal Gadre founded ExamEdge, a consumer test-preparation app for students applying to engineering colleges.
Neha Jhaveri is director of Apex Coaching Institute, which prepares students for medical entrance examinations at three coaching centres.
Suresh Babu Tadikonda manages a reading project at Gram Vikas Trust, working with one government school cluster in Andhra Pradesh.
Pallavi Dixit owns three TinyTrails preschool franchise centres in Delhi serving children aged two to five.
Rajiv Sahni designs leadership training for corporate managers and delivered one workshop for a school in 2023.
Kumaresan Alagappan advises education companies on market entry in South-East Asia and has worked on vocational training projects.
Bhavna Trivedi reports on school policy and board examinations for The Western Chronicle.
Trisha Wadhwani founded Studio Rang and runs a weekend arts programme at two partner schools in Delhi.
Ramesh Kulshreshtha is CFO of Vardhan Auto Components, a manufacturing company. He chairs the company's audit committee.
Anjali Marwah is a principal consultant at Marwah & Gill Strategy, advising retail and FMCG clients on pricing and market strategy.
Siddharth Joglekar founded PeopleStack, a SaaS platform for corporate HR and payroll.
Preeti Narang is Head of Marketing at Hearthside Foods, a packaged foods company.
Yusuf Kagalwala is a partner at Lighthouse Ventures, a venture capital fund investing in fintech start-ups.
Lavanya Subramaniam is Professor of Physics at Southern Technical University, supervising doctoral students in condensed matter research.
Dilip Chaturvedi is Dean of Ganga Institute of Management, a university business school, and chairs its academic council.
Hemant Ghatge founded OverseasPath Admissions, a consultancy that helps university applicants with overseas admissions.
Kirti Salunkhe is founder and consultant at Salunkhe Business Advisory, helping small manufacturers with cost reduction.
Aarav Khemka founded RideNest, a ride-hailing start-up operating in six cities.
Tanvi Bhardwaj is an IT consultant at Bhardwaj Systems, implementing ERP software for logistics companies.
Ravindra Pawar delivers communication and soft-skills workshops to corporate employees.
Smita Deshpande is a research scientist studying university student retention and doctoral outcomes.
Ashok Rathod is managing director of Rathod Realty, a real estate developer building residential towers.
Mitali Barua is Registrar of Brahmaputra State University, managing university examinations and degree records.
Gaurav Seth co-founded SkillRamp, an edtech platform that trains college graduates for software jobs.
Naveen Chopra heads franchise expansion for BrightRank Coaching, a competitive-exam coaching brand.
Anil Deshmukh is Finance Director at Kadamba Textiles, a garment exporter.
Radhika Anantharam speaks about advising school boards at the North India Education Leaders Summit.
Vikram Thondaiman, Group CEO of Meridian Learning Trust, keynoted a conference on scaling school networks.
Sabina Kolhatkar, co-founder of Slate & Chalk, presented the company's curriculum platform at a school-technology expo.
